title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
summary: Untrusted data is placed into a web page without neutralization, enabling script injection.

title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')
summary: Untrusted input is used to construct an SQL command, allowing injected statements.

title: OWASP LLM01: Prompt Injection
summary: Untrusted input alters model behaviour, including indirect injection via retrieved content or tools.

title: OWASP LLM02: Sensitive Information Disclosure
summary: The system discloses sensitive data such as credentials, protected context, or other users' data.

title: Improper Validation of Generative AI Output
summary: Generated output is consumed without validation, allowing downstream injection or unintended actions.
